text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, I visited a flea market in the neighboring
town with Chrono Genesis, which mostly sold antique goods.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of these items carries a sense of history, doesn't it?
...Ah, this is—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A vinyl record with an Umamusume on the cover...
It seems to be a live race commentary recording.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, every single one is a legendary race...
...Yeah, I'm buying this.
choice_data_list: Can you play the record?
Can you play the record?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No, that's impossible, but...
Even so, I want to keep it close at hand.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"From an era when recording media weren't abundant,
the culture of immersing oneself in the races... is historically invaluable."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her heart fluttered at vintage items related to racing.
...I felt that if I could understand that feeling,
I might be able to understand her better."
choice_data_list: I'd love if you taught me about the charm of vintage stuff too.
I want you to teach me about the charm of vintage things too.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? But,
I only talk about it because I love it, so..."
choice_data_list: If anything, I want you to talk about it as much as you like!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I-I understand.
If it's just a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I see... These playing cards
have Umamusume designs on them, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, to think Haiseiko-san is in this photo.
...You can really feel the passion
of that era's racing boom, can't you?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Wait a moment.
That old video game over there is...
choice_data_list: Huh, a video game?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is a game where you become a Trainer
and aim to conquer all GⅠ races alongside your Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Real-life Umamusume appear in it too, so...
If you play, you might get a glimpse of
how the Umamusume of that era were perceived...
choice_data_list: So even that kind of thing interests you, huh.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Relics of the past carry the passion
that people of those eras felt for racing, after all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere of the people who loved racing back then...
These vintage items that let you feel that history
are what I consider true 'historical materials.'
choice_data_list: I see, learning history through the artifacts…

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's an old game,
so I'm not sure how to play it...
Maybe I should ask Love-chan for help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, I toured the flea market alongside her as she browsed with great curiosity...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me...
I seem to have talked a bit too much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However,
everything she talked about was utterly fascinating.
choice_data_list: Maybe I should try buying some 'historical records' too.
Maybe I'll buy some "historical materials" too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking around at the stalls, I spotted various Umamusume merchandise here and there.
T-shirts, caps, plushies...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The item that caught my eye the most among them...
was a pair of glass tumblers engraved with
the silhouette of an Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll go with this one.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san.
...Why do you have that glass?
choice_data_list: I wanted to know the "history" behind this glass...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The delicately carved silhouette of an Umamusume... Its mystical aura gave me the feeling that there might be some historical background to it.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: W-Was I completely off the mark...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no!
I was just a little startled...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Because when I looked at that glass,
I felt the exact same way.
choice_data_list: Huh, Chrono too!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Judging by these meticulous patterns, it was likely
made to commemorate something...
If so, it must be a very special glass.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even I do not know the origins of this glass.
...Which is precisely whyâ

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I want to study it. What kind of feelings
went into making this glass?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To her, this glass seems to be a fascinating "historical artifact" as well.
Fortunately, it's a pair, which means—
choice_data_list: Would you take one of these?
I'd like you to take one.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? N-No, I couldn't accept this.
Especially when it's something you picked out, Trainer...
choice_data_list: That's precisely why I want you to have this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes sparkled as she looked at vintage racing memorabilia,
and she spoke fondly of its history—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely because she was there that I, too,
wanted to learn the racing history
engraved upon this glass.
choice_data_list: This is to thank you for showing me the charm of "historical materials."
This is a thank-you for showing me the charm of "historical materials."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: N-No way... You don't need to thank me.
choice_data_list: Next time, I want you to teach me how to research historical documents.
Next time, I'd like you to teach me how to research historical documents.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...!
...Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, understood.
If I will suffice, I'd be glad to.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. I wonder what kind of history this glass has witnessed...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, truly.
...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Let us unravel history together.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll look into it with everything I've got!
Yeah, I'll do my best to look into it!
To me, you're my teacher when it comes to racing history.
To me, you're a teacher of racing history.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Let us unravel history together.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll look into it with everything I've got!
Yeah, I'll do my best to look into it!
To me, you're my teacher when it comes to racing history.
To me, you're a teacher of racing history.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yes. I look forward
to hearing your insight, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'll review the literature as well...
Let us discuss this glass together.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Teacher...? No, that's an exaggeration.
I just really love the history of racing, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Still, if you ever find yourself interested in historical records again...
please feel free to ask me questions, okay?
